messages:
maya: Hey team — hackweek refapp launch planned for Tue 09:00 PT. Need quick sync on launch post, a short benchmark narrative, a 30‑min webinar slot, and inbound lead routing. Who can own which part?
alex: I can take the launch post + social snippets. Want to highlight private deploy + cost/perf tradeoffs.
sam: I can handle the benchmark narrative. Thinking we do 3 microbenchmarks: cold-start latency, throughput at 1k rps, and cost-per-token comparison vs baseline. Short, repeatable scripts.
jordan: Webinar slot — I suggest Wed 11am PT to catch EU and US overlap. 30 mins + 10 Q&A. Ops can provision demo environment. @ops-bot can you confirm infra?
ops-bot: Scheduled ephemeral demo cluster: 4xA10G, 2x16vCPU jumpbox, public demo token (read-only). Cluster expires in 48h after event. Link: https://demo.internal/redwood/hackweek-gnarly
lucy: For inbound leads, marketing automation should create campaign tag "hackweek-gnarly-refapp" and route heavy interest (opens + demo clicks) to AE queue A. Low-engage to nurture. I can draft the routing map.
maya: Great. Sam — can you include the command snippets for the benchmark + small dataset so people can reproduce? Keep it < 10 lines.
sam: Sure, rough draft snippet:
```
# cold-start latency
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"short prompt"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
# throughput: wrk config
wrk -t4 -c200 -d60s --latency http://demo.local/generate
```
maya: Perfect. Alex — for the post, I want a 150–250 word narrative + 3 callouts: 1) private deploy ease, 2) predictable latency, 3) cost-saving levers (batching, quant). Also include a one‑liner hero metric.
alex: Draft will be in #marketing-drafts by EOD today. Will propose hero: "3–5x lower tail latency vs generic endpoint at 512 tokens" — Sam pls confirm numbers.
sam: I can back that with benchmark runs. Expect to deliver numbers + small table (3 rows) by tomorrow noon.
jordan: Webinar agenda draft: (1) 5m intro, (2) 10m demo (deploy + routing + console), (3) 10m benchmark walkthrough, (4) 5m Q&A. I'll own the demo slides and Q&A queue.
lucy: Lead form fields: org, role, use-case checkbox (prod/dedicated/private), interest-level slider, "want pilot" checkbox. Map to SFDC campaign ID: MKG-HW-2026-01.
maya: Communication plan: post publish -> 1h social push -> email blast to community list -> webinar registration link -> 24h reminder -> webinar day. Alex, can you draft email copy for both announcement and reminder?
alex: Yep. Short subject lines: "Hackweek: Build a private refapp in 30 min" and reminder "Tomorrow: live demo & benchmarks".
ops-bot: Reminder: demo cluster will be live Mon 06:00 PT for dry runs. Please don't use prod tokens.
maya: Follow-ups: Sam finalize numbers, Alex write post + emails, Jordan slide deck + webinar page, Lucy routing + form. Check-in tomorrow 10:00 PT. Any blockers?
sam: None. I'll post reproducible scripts and raw logs to the shared folder.
jordan: I'll sync with legal on demo data wording.
lucy: I'll pair with ops on the webhook mapping to make sure lead tags are present.
maya: Awesome — thanks everyone :rocket:
